state.primary-publication.md: Run primary-publication.js with input {"entry_id":"1CRN"} (or another four-character PDB entry). Uses only credential-free public reads on data.rcsb.org and api.crossref.org. RCSB's rcsb_primary_citation explicitly identifies the primary publication; Crossref must identify the matching DOI as a journal-article, not a dataset. Checks title (ignoring punctuation/case), publication year, volume and pages. Returns Crossref's exact title array and publisher. Crossref /works/{doi} was discovered from https://api.crossref.org/swagger-docs. Verified 1CRN: DOI 10.1073/pnas.81.19.6014; article published 1984, volume 81, pages 6014-6018. Throws on missing or inconsistent evidence.
